purpose: Descriptively test whether real-observation horizon error is associated with the first-action update difference between student-ranked and teacher-ranked elites in the same frozen CEM banks.
claim_boundary: Read-only mechanism analysis only. It does not establish causality, an independent validation result, planner deployment, closed-loop improvement, or a training recommendation.

scope.aggregate_rounds: median across rounds 10, 20, and 30 within each episode and replan step

allowed_missing_solve.rule: Emit a t25 episode row with unavailable metrics; do not impute it or replace the episode.

metrics.ranking: For each bank, use ascending torch.argsort(cost)[:30] independently for student and teacher. Teacher-elite regret is (mean teacher cost on student top30 - mean teacher cost on teacher top30) / population_std(teacher costs, unbiased=false).
metrics.first_action_mean_displacement: Take candidates[top30, 0, :] with shape [30,10], average each elite set, then compute the L2 norm of student-elite mean minus teacher-elite mean.
metrics.first_action_normalization: Divide the raw displacement L2 by sqrt(sum_j(population_std(candidates[:,0,j], unbiased=false)^2)); fail closed if this scalar is non-finite or <= 1e-8.
metrics.real_observation_error: At the matching episode/replan solve, record student_relative_mse - teacher_relative_mse at horizons 1 and 5; the horizon increment is the horizon-5 difference minus the horizon-1 difference.
metrics.episode_aggregation: Take the median of each bank metric over exactly rounds 10, 20, and 30 for one episode and replan step. Real-observation horizon metrics remain one value per episode and solve.
metrics.correlation: Compute tie-aware Spearman rank correlation across episode rows separately for t0 and t25. Report n and coefficient only; include paired scatter values in the episode rows and do not compute p-values or treat banks/rounds as independent samples.
